questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered 1, 2 and 3. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

1. All cottons are silks.

2. All silks are wools.

3. All wools are jutes.

Conclusions:

1. Some jutes are silks.

2. Some wools are cottons.

3. Some jutes are cottons.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

1. All cottons are silks.

2. All silks are wools.

3. All wools are jutes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0081d7883aa874bee933623e46710cf9f3b5710ff89b40b4016ef171497ba3e4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some jutes are silks - True (Because, All silks are wools and All wools are jutes, so Some jutes are silks will be definitely true).

II. Some wools are cottons - True (Because, All cottons are silks and All silks are wools, so Some wools are cottons will be definitely true).

III. Some jutes are cottons - True (Because, All silks are wools, All wools are jutes and All wools are jutes, so Some jutes are cottons will be definitely true).

So, All conclusions 1, 2 and 3 follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: When a household’s income falls below the amount required to sustain basic living standards (food, shelter, housing), is called ______.
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Absolute Poverty** refers to the **lack of basic necessities** required to sustain **human life**, such as **food, shelter, and clothing.**
 
• It is a condition of **severe deprivation **of basic human needs, where individuals cannot afford to meet their basic requirements.
 
• Numerous **social, economic, and political** factors can contribute to or result from poverty.

 We are able to enhance the **general health** of every person on the earth by eliminating poverty worldwide. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Relative Poverty** refers to the situation where a** person's income falls below** a certain percentage of the median income of the society they live in.
 
• **Generational Poverty** is a situation where **poverty is passed down** from **one generation to the next **due to lack of education, skills, and opportunities.
 
• **Situational Poverty** is a temporary condition where individuals or households **experience poverty due to unforeseen circumstances** such as job loss, illness, or natural disasters.

questions.question: A runs at a speed that is (11)/(9) times the speed of B. If B is allowed to have a head start such that B beats A by (1)/(3) of the length of the race, what part of the length of the race has been given as head start to B over A? [Note: Consider A and B to start running at the same time.]
questions.solution:
**Given**

A's speed = 11/9 times B's speed

B beats A by 1/3 of the length of the race

**Calculation:**

The ratio of speed of A and B is 11 : 9

Let the total race be 90 units.

Let the head start given by B to A is x.

Total distance covered by A = 60 units which is 1/3 less of total distance.

Total distance covered by B = 90 - x

According to the question:

⇒ 60/11 = (90 - x)/9

⇒ 11x = 450

⇒ x = 450/11

The part is = 450/(11 × 90) = 5/11

**Therefore, the part of the length of the race that has been given as a head start to B over A is 5/11.**
